episodes.synopsis: Sheena is an orphan who is trained for war, even though she doesn't want to be. And one day, she meets Mimi.
episodes.title: The Kiss

episodes.synopsis: Sheena, Mimi, and their classmates get sent into the forest to fight 100 magical enemies in a combat exercise.
episodes.title: It Does Hurt

episodes.synopsis: After Sheena realizes she wants to make friends with Mimi, Mimi decides to share an important secret with her.
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: Sheena tries to learn more about Mimi's condition but is confronted by Ms. Fran and sworn to absolute secrecy.
episodes.title: Accomplices

episodes.synopsis: Sheena struggles to understand Mimi's mysterious curse and her seemingly nonchalant attitude toward the war.
episodes.title: Endless Night

episodes.synopsis: The war escalates. When Mimi isn't enough, the school makes a drastic decision.
episodes.title: Welcome Home

episodes.synopsis: Despite struggling somewhat during her combat test against Mimi, Seiran volunteers to go into actual battle.
episodes.title: Not Afraid Anymore

episodes.synopsis: Ari struggles to process the material and emotional consequences of Seiran's brief tenure on the battlefield.
episodes.title: I'm Back

episodes.synopsis: Sheena visits Ms. Fran for advice on how to use her magical abilities to better help the school and her peers.
episodes.title: My Magic

episodes.synopsis: As Sheena keeps working to improve her magic, she and Mimi get acquainted with a somewhat reclusive classmate.
episodes.title: An Unforgettable Day

episodes.synopsis: Mimi keeps getting called to battle, but Sheena is relieved that she keeps coming home practically untouched.
episodes.title: Untarnished

episodes.synopsis: Sheena and Mimi search for a way to come to an understanding and reaffirm their friendship after an argument.
episodes.title: As I Am
